question: Which deities are to be included together with the world guardians in worship?
premises: Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Mahādeva are named.
They are associated with the world guardians.
inference: Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Mahādeva, and Viśākhā are to be worshipped together with the world guardians.
uncertainties: The grammatical role of viśākhāṃ in this list is slightly ambiguous.
plain_english: One should worship Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Mahādeva, and Viśākhā together with the world guardians.
